ruling.recommended_action: Issue a Ryde voucher of $3.33 to the rider (RD-2 metered-mileage overcharge on the 2.36 non-exempt extra km of the off-route segment) and note the RD-1 breach on the driver's record.
ruling.reasoning:
The trip is a metered RydeTAXI journey: optimal route 16.5 km, 19.1 km driven, +2.6 km (+16%) [F1], with one measured off-route segment 21:57–22:04 driving 4.13 km where the optimal route covers 1.77 km, adding 2.36 km and reaching up to 1304 m off the optimal route [F3]. That segment is an off-route segment under RD-1, and none of the exemptions excuses it, so RD-2 applies and the extra metered kilometres on it are refundable [F3][RD-1][RD-2].

RD-5 fails: the case has no in-app chat at all [F8], so no rider message sent before 21:57:35 agrees to the route. The only proffered agreement is the driver's post-trip statement "I went round it" [F9]; a driver's claim of agreement appearing only in his statement is not consent, and a message after the segment began cannot establish consent [F9][F8][RD-5]. RD-3 gives no relief either — no rider-named stop was measured in this segment, so nothing is exempt on that basis [F3][RD-3].

RD-4 does not exempt the segment: the Ayer Rajah Expressway accident was reported at 22:07, 0 m from the optimal route but after the off-route segment had already begun at 21:57 and near trip end, so it cannot be the reasonable cause for the stretch already driven [F3][F12]; the speed-band records (band 4, 30–39 km/h, not band 1 or 2) are only corroborative and speed band alone never exempts [F10][F11][RD-4]. The driver's "accident … unavoidable" claim is therefore not corroborated for the replaced stretch [F9][RD-4].

Amount, per the trace formula: this trip's per-km rate = fare distance fare ÷ distance km = $26.93 ÷ 19.10 km = $1.4099/km [F7]; the non-exempt segment's extra 2.36 km × $1.4099/km = $3.33 [F3][F7][RD-2]. The 0.1 min meter waiting ($0.02) is RydeTAXI meter waiting time on a stop and is not refunded [F5][RD-3]. RD-6 is not triggered — 0 upheld route disputes in 90 days — so no account flag is added [F15][RD-6].
